verdict.rationale: x402 is API-first by design. Payment gating, verification and settlement all run over HTTP through the facilitator API and SDK. Service discovery is a keyless public API with a generated OpenAPI client and an MCP server, and the runtime probe confirmed both the live discovery endpoint and the facilitator API. Agents also get programmatic wallets that pay directly, so no documented capability appears to require a UI. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity; evidence that account-level tasks such as CDP API-key provisioning and facilitator configuration can be done without a portal; a published OpenAPI spec at the probed paths.
